brief:
Chris Hedges and Joe Sacco have published "Requiem for Gaza," a new book examining the conflict in Gaza and its implications for the international system, the Chris Hedges Report said. The work combines reporting and visual documentation to explore conditions on the ground and broader geopolitical consequences of the crisis.

Hedges and Sacco discussed the book's creation and findings, addressing how the Gaza situation reflects deterioration in the Western-led international order. The publication represents their collaboration on documenting and analyzing one of the region's most significant recent humanitarian events.
dek: Chris Hedges and Joe Sacco discuss the making of their new book, how it came to be, and what its content means about the decaying Western international order.
title: Hedges and Sacco release visual account of Gaza crisis
